description: The OBC source arm. NOT a CSV manifest: the trainer builds it through OBCCrossDataset, whose subject-disjoint split is recomputed at import time from a fixed seed, not stored.
caution: Because the split is recomputed rather than stored, it is a function of the seed AND of the sorted subject list. It would change silently if the cache were ever rebuilt with a different subject set. The cache is frozen and read-only, so this cannot happen without notice.
